text:
Maria: Quick heads-up — tiny hotfix for 2.1.7 to address kvcache TTL regression. Target cutoff today 18:00 UTC. Need a cherrypick + quick smoke.
Kevin: I can handle the cherrypick. Which PR/commit should I pick?
Maria: PR #4876 — commit 1a2b3c4. From main into release/2.1.x. Patch-only, no dependency changes.
Kevin: Got it. I'll open cherrypick PR to release/2.1.x and run CI. Cherry-pick command I'll use:
```
git fetch origin
git checkout release/2.1.x
git cherry-pick -x 1a2b3c4
```
Kevin: Opening PR now, will ping when CI is green and ready for review.
Samir: Changelog note should be one line. Suggest: "Fix: kvcache TTL regression causing increased latency under load (affects 2.1.x) — @Kevin"
Maria: Yes keep changelog minimal. Add the single line under "Bug fixes" and include the PR link. I'll sign off on release notes after merge.
Ashley: I can do the smoke once CI is green. Plan to run the normal canary checklist at 18:10 UTC (post-cutoff) and report status here.
Kevin: CI passed for cherrypick PR (#4890). Marking for review and will request an expedited LGTM.
deploy-bot: CI: #4890 — all checks passed ✅ — mergeable.
Kevin: Merged and bumped release/2.1.x to 2.1.7. Tag created: v2.1.7. Tag push: `git push origin v2.1.7`.
Kevin: Rollback plan: revert the cherry-pick commit on release/2.1.x and redeploy previous tag if issues are seen. I'll include the revert steps in the PR description.
Samir: :thumbsup: noted the rollback steps.
Ashley: Running the smoke tests now (canary subset). Will post a short checklist once done: startup, kvcache sanity, simple gen latency, and health endpoints.
Ashley: Smoke looks clean so far — kvcache TTL behavior back to expected on canary nodes. No obvious latency regression.
Maria: Thanks all. Cutoff remains 18:00 UTC — merged before cutoff, release tagged. Proceeding with the cutover window at 18:10 UTC. If anything unexpected, revert to v2.1.6.
Kevin: Thanks team. I'll follow up with the PR link and short changelog line in release notes.
Ashley: ack.
Maria: Closing loop once console shows stable post-cut.
